Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously sent.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Reference to a linked message that was previously received.

OrderReference.name: Order Reference
OrderReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifiers of one or more individual order instructions or individual order cancellation requests.

ReferenceElementRule.definition: One of the elements (Reference, RelatedReference, OrderReference) must be present.
